name: crab-office
description: Every running Claude Code session and its subagents as a pixel-art office: departments by project, org-chart teams, a shared board, a CEO you appoint, meetings between sessions, and btw questions to any crab

language.title: Language
language.description: The office's language: en for English, zh for Chinese

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: full: the office works its sessions (memos, instructions, the CEO, meetings); observe: it only shows them and sends them nothing. A session run with -p or the SDK always only observes.
